authorInfo.bio: Stephen Crane was an American poet, novelist, and short story writer. Prolific throughout his short life, he wrote notable works in the Realist tradition as well as early examples of American Naturalism and Impressionism. He is recognized by modern critics as one of the most innovative writers of his generation.

sourceTitle: The Little Regiment, and Other Episodes of the American Civil War
description: "The Little Regiment, and Other Episodes of the American Civil War" by Stephen Crane is a collection of short stories written during the late 19th century, capturing the tumult and chaos of the American Civil War. The narratives often focus on the experiences of soldiers, delving into their emotions, camaraderie, and the harsh realities of battle, which reflect both the physical and psychological impact of war.
